name: Paradise Hotel
description: A group of hot singles check into a luxury hotel in Mexico. Prepare for love, partying, betrayal and tears. Half a million kronor is at stake and anything can happen in paradise.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A new, excited group checks into the hotel and the first five couples of the season are formed. Guests are quickly reminded that “anything can happen at Paradise Hotel” when a letter arrives.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Paradise Hotel's very own butterfly checks in and breaks up a couple. The game is on, pacts begin to form, and after just two days in paradise, one of the guests' stay at the hotel is soon over.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: One guest checks out and jealousy and concern grow among the remaining guests. A letter checks in and starts to stir the pot. Who can you really trust?
